info.description: A recurring class slot on the weekly timetable — weekday, start/end time, class, coach, and capacity.

content-manager.label: Class
content-manager.description: Which class is scheduled in this time slot.

content-manager.label: Day of Week
content-manager.description: Which day this slot runs every week.

content-manager.label: Start Time
content-manager.description: Time the class begins in 24-hour format, e.g. 06:00.

content-manager.label: End Time
content-manager.description: Time the class ends in 24-hour format, e.g. 07:00.

content-manager.label: Maximum Capacity
content-manager.description: Maximum number of participants allowed per session.

content-manager.label: Room / Area
content-manager.description: Which part of the gym this runs in, e.g. "Main Floor" or "Boxing Ring".

content-manager.label: Active on Schedule?
content-manager.description: Only active slots are shown on the public schedule page.

content-manager.label: Internal Notes
content-manager.description: Private notes for the team — not shown on the public website.
